v.t: Ha, Meem
v.l: Ha-Mim

v.t: By the Book that makes things clear
v.l: Wa Al-Kitabi Al-Mubini

v.t: We made it an Arabic Quran, so that you may understand
v.l: Inna Ja`alnahu Qur'anaan `Arabiyaan La`allakum Ta`qiluna

v.t: And it is with Us, in the Source Book, sublime and wise
v.l: Wa 'Innahu Fi 'Ummi Al-Kitabi Ladayna La`aliyun Hakimun

v.t: Shall We hold back the Reminder from you, since you are a transgressing people
v.l: Afanađribu `Ankumu Adh-Dhikra Safhaan 'An Kuntum Qawmaan Musrifina

v.t: How many a prophet did We send to the ancients
v.l: Wa Kam 'Arsalna Min Nabiyin Fi Al-'Awwalina

v.t: No messenger came to them, but they ridiculed him
v.l: Wa Ma Ya'tihim Min Nabiyin 'Illa Kanu Bihi Yastahzi'un

v.t: We destroyed people more powerful than they, and so the example of the ancients has passed away
v.l: Fa'ahlakna 'Ashadda Minhum Batshaan Wa Mađa Mathalu Al-'Awwalina

v.t: And if you asked them, “Who created the heavens and the earth?” They would say, “The Mighty, the Knower created them.”
v.l: Wa La'in Sa'altahum Man Khalaqa As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđa Layaqulunna Khalaqahunna Al-`Azizu Al-`Alimu

v.t: He who made the earth a habitat for you, and traced pathways for you on it, that you may be guided
v.l: Al-Ladhi Ja`ala Lakumu Al-'Arđa Mahdaan Wa Ja`ala Lakum Fiha Subulaan La`allakum Tahtaduna

v.t: He who sends down water from the sky in due proportion; and so We revive thereby a dead land. Thus you will be brought out
v.l: Wa Al-Ladhi Nazzala Mina As-Sama'i Ma'an Biqadarin Fa'ansharna Bihi Baldatan Maytaan Kadhalika Tukhrajuna

v.t: He Who created all the pairs; and provided you with ships, and animals on which you ride
v.l: Wa Al-Ladhi Khalaqa Al-'Azwaja Kullaha Wa Ja`ala Lakum Mina Al-Fulki Wa Al-'An`am Ma Tarkabuna

v.t: That you may mount their backs, and remember the favor of your Lord as you sit firmly upon them, and say, “Glory be to Him Who placed these at our service; surely we could not have done it by ourselves
v.l: Litastawu `Ala Zuhurihi Thumma Tadhkuru Ni`mata Rabbikum 'Idha Astawaytum `Alayhi Wa Taqulu Subhana Al-Ladhi Sakhkhara Lana Hadha Wa Ma Kunna Lahu Muqrinina

v.t: And surely, to our Lord we will return.”
v.l: Wa 'Inna 'Ila Rabbina Lamunqalibuna

v.t: Yet they turn one of His servants into a part of Him. Man is clearly ungrateful
v.l: Wa Ja`alu Lahu Min `Ibadihi Juz'aan 'Inna Al-'Insana Lakafurun Mubinun

v.t: Or has He chosen for Himself daughters from what He creates, and favored you with sons
v.l: Am Attakhadha Mimma Yakhluqu Banatin Wa 'Asfakum Bil-Banina

v.t: Yet when one of them is given news of what he attributes to the Most Gracious, his face darkens, and he suppresses grief
v.l: Wa 'Idha Bushira 'Ahaduhum Bima Đaraba Lilrrahmani Mathalaan Zalla Wajhuhu Muswaddaan Wa Huwa Kazimun

v.t: “Someone brought up to be beautiful, and unable to help in a fight?”
v.l: Awaman Yunasha'u Fi Al-Hilyati Wa Huwa Fi Al-Khisami Ghayru Mubinin

v.t: And they appoint the angels, who are servants to the Most Gracious, as females. Have they witnessed their creation? Their claim will be recorded, and they will be questioned
v.l: Wa Ja`alu Al-Mala'ikata Al-Ladhina Hum `Ibadu Ar-Rahmani 'Inathaan 'Ashahidu Khalqahum Satuktabu Shahadatuhum Wa Yus'aluna

v.t: And they say, “Had the Most Gracious willed, we would not have worshiped them.” But they have no knowledge of that; they are merely guessing
v.l: Wa Qalu Law Sha'a Ar-Rahmanu Ma `Abadnahum Ma Lahum Bidhalika Min `Ilmin 'In Hum 'Illa Yakhrusuna
w: we would not have worshipped them
we would not have worshipped them

v.t: Or have We given them a book prior to this one, to which they adhere
v.l: Am 'Ataynahum Kitabaan Min Qablihi Fahum Bihi Mustamsikuna

v.t: But they say, “We found our parents on a course, and we are guided in their footsteps.”
v.l: Bal Qalu 'Inna Wajadna 'Aba'ana `Ala 'Ummatin Wa 'Inna `Ala 'Atharihim Muhtaduna

v.t: Likewise, We sent no warner before you to any town, but the wealthy among them said, “We found our parents on a course, and we are following in their footsteps.”
v.l: Wa Kadhalika Ma 'Arsalna Min Qablika Fi Qaryatin Min Nadhirin 'Illa Qala Mutrafuha 'Inna Wajadna 'Aba'ana `Ala 'Ummatin Wa 'Inna `Ala 'Atharihim Muqtaduna

v.t: He would say, “Even if I bring you better guidance than what you found your parents following?” They would say, “We reject what you are sent with.”
v.l: Qala 'Awalaw Ji'tukum Bi'ahda Mimma Wajadtum `Alayhi 'Aba'akum Qalu 'Inna Bima 'Ursiltum Bihi Kafiruna

v.t: So We wreaked vengeance upon them. Behold, then, what was the fate of those who deny
v.l: Fantaqamna Minhum Fanzur Kayfa Kana `Aqibatu Al-Mukadhibina

v.t: When Abraham said to his father and his people, “I am innocent of what you worship
v.l: Wa 'Idh Qala 'Ibrahimu Li'abihi Wa Qawmihi 'Innani Bara'un Mimma Ta`buduna

v.t: Except for He who created me, for He will guide me.”
v.l: Illa Al-Ladhi Fatarani Fa'innahu Sayahdini

v.t: And he made it an enduring word in his progeny, so that they may return
v.l: Wa Ja`alaha Kalimatan Baqiyatan Fi `Aqibihi La`allahum Yarji`una

v.t: I gave these and their forefathers some enjoyment, until the truth and a manifest messenger came to them
v.l: Bal Matta`tu Ha'uula' Wa 'Aba'ahum Hatta Ja'ahumu Al-Haqqu Wa Rasulun Mubinun

v.t: But when the truth came to them, they said, “This is sorcery, and we refuse to believe in it.”
v.l: Wa Lamma Ja'ahumu Al-Haqqu Qalu Hadha Sihrun Wa 'Inna Bihi Kafiruna

v.t: They also said, “If only this Quran was sent down to a man of importance from the two cities.”
v.l: Wa Qalu Lawla Nuzzila Hadha Al-Qur'anu `Ala Rajulin Mina Al-Qaryatayni `Azimin

v.t: Is it they who allocate the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have allocated their livelihood in this life, and We elevated some of them in rank above others, that some of them would take others in service. But your Lord’s mercy is better than what they amass
v.l: Ahum Yaqsimuna Rahmata Rabbika Nahnu Qasamna Baynahum Ma`ishatahum Fi Al-Hayaati Ad-Dunya Wa Rafa`na Ba`đahum Fawqa Ba`đin Darajatin Liyattakhidha Ba`đuhum Ba`đaan Sukhriyaan Wa Rahmatu Rabbika Khayrun Mimma Yajma`una

v.t: Were it not that humanity would become a single community, We would have provided those who disbelieve in the Most Gracious with roofs of silver to their houses, and stairways by which they ascend
v.l: Wa Lawla 'An Yakuna An-Nasu 'Ummatan Wahidatan Laja`alna Liman Yakfuru Bir-Rahmani Libuyutihim Suqufaan Min Fađđatin Wa Ma`arija `Alayha Yazharuna

v.t: And doors to their houses, and furnishings on which they recline
v.l: Wa Libuyutihim 'Abwabaan Wa Sururaan `Alayha Yattaki'una

v.t: And decorations. Yet all that is nothing but the stuff of this life. Yet the Hereafter, with your Lord, is for the righteous
v.l: Wa Zukhrufaan Wa 'In Kullu Dhalika Lamma Mata`u Al-Hayaati Ad-Dunya Wa Al-'Akhiratu `Inda Rabbika Lilmuttaqina

v.t: Whoever shuns the remembrance of the Most Gracious, We assign for him a devil, to be his companion
v.l: Wa Man Ya`shu `An Dhikri Ar-Rahmani Nuqayyiđ Lahu Shaytanaan Fahuwa Lahu Qarinun

v.t: They hinder them from the path, though they think they are guided
v.l: Wa 'Innahum Layasuddunahum `Ani As-Sabili Wa Yahsabuna 'Annahum Muhtaduna

v.t: Until, when He comes to Us, he will say, “If only there were between me and you the distance of the two Easts.” What an evil companion
v.l: Hatta 'Idha Ja'ana Qala Ya Layta Bayni Wa Baynaka Bu`da Al-Mashriqayni Fabi'sa Al-Qarinu

v.t: It will not benefit you on that Day, since you did wrong. You are partners in the suffering
v.l: Wa Lan Yanfa`akumu Al-Yawma 'Idh Zalamtum 'Annakum Fi Al-`Adhabi Mushtarikuna

v.t: Can you make the deaf hear, or guide the blind, and him who is in evident error
v.l: Afa'anta Tusmi`u As-Summa 'Aw Tahdi Al-`Umya Wa Man Kana Fi Đalalin Mubinin

v.t: Even if We take you away, We will wreak vengeance upon them
v.l: Fa'imma Nadh/habanna Bika Fa'inna Minhum Muntaqimuna

v.t: Or show you what We have promised them; for We have absolute power over them
v.l: Aw Nuriyannaka Al-Ladhi Wa`adnahum Fa'inna `Alayhim Muqtadiruna

v.t: So adhere to what is revealed to you. You are upon a straight path
v.l: Fastamsik Bial-Ladhi 'Uhiya 'Ilayka 'Innaka `Ala Siratin Mustaqimin

v.t: It is a message for you, and for your people; and you will be questioned
v.l: Wa 'Innahu Ladhikrun Laka Wa Liqawmika Wa Sawfa Tus'aluna

v.t: Ask those of Our messengers We sent before you: “Did We appoint gods besides the Most Gracious to be worshiped?”
v.l: Wa As'al Man 'Arsalna Min Qablika Min Rusulina 'Aja`alna Min Duni Ar-Rahmani 'Alihatan Yu`baduna

v.t: We sent Moses with Our revelations to Pharaoh and his dignitaries. He said, “I am the Messenger of the Lord of the Worlds.”
v.l: Wa Laqad 'Arsalna Musa Bi'ayatina 'Ila Fir`awna Wa Mala'ihi Faqala 'Inni Rasulu Rabbi Al-`Alamina

v.t: But when he showed them Our signs, they started laughing at them
v.l: Falamma Ja'ahum Bi'ayatina 'Idha Hum Minha Yađhakuna

v.t: Each sign We showed them was more marvelous than its counterpart. And We afflicted them with the plagues, so that they may repent
v.l: Wa Ma Nurihim Min 'Ayatin 'Illa Hiya 'Akbaru Min 'Ukhtiha Wa 'Akhadhnahum Bil-`Adhabi La`allahum Yarji`una

v.t: They said, “O sorcerer, pray to your Lord for us, according to His pledge to you, and then we will be guided.”
v.l: Wa Qalu Ya 'Ayyuha As-Sahiru Ad`u Lana Rabbaka Bima `Ahida `Indaka 'Innana Lamuhtadun

v.t: But when We lifted the torment from them, they immediately broke their promise
v.l: Falamma Kashafna `Anhumu Al-`Adhaba 'Idha Hum Yankuthuna

v.t: Pharaoh proclaimed among his people, saying, “O my people, do I not own the Kingdom of Egypt, and these rivers flow beneath me? Do you not see
v.l: Wa Nada Fir`awnu Fi Qawmihi Qala Ya Qawmi 'Alaysa Li Mulku Misra Wa Hadhihi Al-'Anharu Tajri Min Tahti 'Afala Tubsiruna

v.t: Am I not better than this miserable wretch, who can barely express himself
v.l: Am 'Ana Khayrun Min Hadha Al-Ladhi Huwa Mahinun Wa La Yakadu Yubinu

v.t: Why are bracelets of gold not dropped on him, or they angels came with him in procession?”
v.l: Falawla 'Ulqiya `Alayhi 'Aswiratun Min Dhahabin 'Aw Ja'a Ma`ahu Al-Mala'ikatu Muqtarinina

v.t: Thus he fooled his people, and they obeyed him. They were wicked people
v.l: Fastakhaffa Qawmahu Fa'ata`uhu 'Innahum Kanu Qawmaan Fasiqina

v.t: And when they provoked Our wrath, We took retribution from them, and We drowned them all
v.l: Falamma 'Asafuna Antaqamna Minhum Fa'aghraqnahum 'Ajma`ina

v.t: Thus We made them a precedent and an example for the others
v.l: Faja`alnahum Salafaan Wa Mathalaan Lil'akhirina

v.t: And when the son of Mary was cited as an example, your people opposed
v.l: Wa Lamma Đuriba Abnu Maryama Mathalaan 'Idha Qawmuka Minhu Yasidduna

v.t: They said, “Are our gods better, or he?” They cited him only for argument. In fact, they are a quarrelsome people
v.l: Wa Qalu 'A'alihatuna Khayrun 'Am Huwa Ma Đarabuhu Laka 'Illa Jadalaan Bal Hum Qawmun Khasimuna

v.t: He was just a servant whom We blessed, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel
v.l: In Huwa 'Illa `Abdun 'An`amna `Alayhi Wa Ja`alnahu Mathalaan Libani 'Isra'ila

v.t: Had We willed, We would have made of you angels to be successors on earth
v.l: Wa Law Nasha'u Laja`alna Minkum Mala'ikatan Fi Al-'Arđi Yakhlufuna

v.t: He is a portent of the Hour, so have no doubt about it, and follow Me. This is a straight way
v.l: Wa 'Innahu La`ilmun Lilssa`ati Fala Tamtarunna Biha Wa Attabi`uni Hadha Siratun Mustaqimun

v.t: And let not Satan divert you. He is an open enemy to you
v.l: Wa La Yasuddannakumu Ash-Shaytanu 'Innahu Lakum `Aduwun Mubinun

v.t: When Jesus came with the clarifications, he said, “I have come to you with wisdom, and to clarify for you some of what you differ about. So fear God, and obey me
v.l: Wa Lamma Ja'a `Isa Bil-Bayyinati Qala Qad Ji'tukum Bil-Hikmati Wa Li'abayyina Lakum Ba`đa Al-Ladhi Takhtalifuna Fihi Fa Attaqu Allaha Wa 'Ati`uni

v.t: God is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him—this is a straight path.”
v.l: Inna Allaha Huwa Rabbi Wa Rabbukum Fa`buduhu Hadha Siratun Mustaqimun

v.t: But the factions differed among themselves. So woe to the wrongdoers from the suffering of a painful Day
v.l: Fakhtalafa Al-'Ahzabu Min Baynihim Fawaylun Lilladhina Zalamu Min `Adhabi Yawmin 'Alimin

v.t: Are they only waiting for the Hour to come upon them suddenly, while they are unaware
v.l: Hal Yanzuruna 'Illa As-Sa`ata 'An Ta'tiyahum Baghtatan Wa Hum La Yash`uruna

v.t: On that Day, friends will be enemies of one another, except for the righteous
v.l: Al-'Akhilla'u Yawma'idhin Ba`đuhum Liba`đin `Aduwun 'Illa Al-Muttaqina

v.t: O My servants, you have nothing to fear on that Day, nor will you grieve
v.l: Ya `Ibadi La Khawfun `Alaykumu Al-Yawma Wa La 'Antum Tahzanuna

v.t: Those who believed in Our revelations, and were submissive
v.l: Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Bi'ayatina Wa Kanu Muslimina

v.t: Enter the Garden, you and your spouses, Joyfully
v.l: Adkhulu Al-Jannata 'Antum Wa 'Azwajukum Tuhbaruna

v.t: They will be served around with trays of gold, and cups. Therein is whatever the souls desire and delights the eyes. Therein you will stay forever
v.l: Yutafu `Alayhim Bisihafin Min Dhahabin Wa 'Akwabin Wa Fiha Ma Tashtahihi Al-'Anfusu Wa Taladhu Al-'A`yunu Wa 'Antum Fiha Khaliduna

v.t: Such is the Garden you are made to inherit, because of what you used to do
v.l: Wa Tilka Al-Jannatu Allati 'Urithtumuha Bima Kuntum Ta`maluna

v.t: Therein you will have abundant fruit, from which you eat
v.l: Lakum Fiha Fakihatun Kathiratun Minha Ta'kuluna

v.t: As for the sinners, they will be in the torment of Hell forever
v.l: Inna Al-Mujrimina Fi `Adhabi Jahannama Khalidun

v.t: It will never be eased for them. In it, they will be devastated
v.l: La Yufattaru `Anhum Wa Hum Fihi Mublisuna

v.t: We did them no injustice, but it was they who were the unjust
v.l: Wa Ma Zalamnahum Wa Lakin Kanu Humu Az-Zalimina

v.t: And they will cry, “O Malek, let your Lord finish us off.” He will say, “You are staying.”
v.l: Wa Nadaw Ya Maliku Liyaqđi `Alayna Rabbuka Qala 'Innakum Makithuna

v.t: We have given you the truth, but most of you hate the truth
v.l: Laqad Ji'nakum Bil-Haqqi Wa Lakinna 'Aktharakum Lilhaqqi Karihuna

v.t: Have they contrived some scheme? We too are contriving
v.l: Am 'Abramu 'Amraan Fa'inna Mubrimuna

v.t: Or do they think that We cannot hear their secrets and their conspiracies? Yes indeed, Our messengers are by them, writing down
v.l: Am Yahsabuna 'Anna La Nasma`u Sirrahum Wa Najwahum Bala Wa Rusuluna Ladayhim Yaktubuna

v.t: Say, “If the Most Gracious had a son, I would be the first to worship.”
v.l: Qul 'In Kana Lilrrahmani Waladun Fa'ana 'Awwalu Al-`Abidina

v.t: Glorified be the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, beyond what they describe
v.l: Subhana Rabbi As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđi Rabbi Al-`Arshi `Amma Yasifuna

v.t: So leave them to blunder and play, until they encounter their Day which they are promised
v.l: Fadharhum Yakhuđu Wa Yal`abu Hatta Yulaqu Yawmahumu Al-Ladhi Yu`aduna

v.t: It is He who is God in heaven, and God on earth. He is the Wise, the Knower
v.l: Wa Huwa Al-Ladhi Fi As-Sama'i 'Ilahun Wa Fi Al-'Arđi 'Ilahun Wa Huwa Al-Hakimu Al-`Alimu

v.t: And blessed is He Who has sovereignty over the heavens and the earth and what is between them. He alone has knowledge of the Hour, and to Him you will be returned
v.l: Wa Tabaraka Al-Ladhi Lahu Mulku As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđi Wa Ma Baynahuma Wa `Indahu `Ilmu As-Sa`ati Wa 'Ilayhi Turja`una

v.t: Those they invoke besides Him are incapable of intercession; only those who testify to the truth and have knowledge
v.l: Wa La Yamliku Al-Ladhina Yad`una Min Dunihi Ash-Shafa`ata 'Illa Man Shahida Bil-Haqqi Wa Hum Ya`lamuna

v.t: And if you asked them, “Who created them?”, they would say, “God.” Why then do they deviate
v.l: Wa La'in Sa'altahum Man Khalaqahum Layaqulunna Allahu Fa'anna Yu'ufakuna

v.t: As for his statement: “My Lord, these are a people who do not believe.”
v.l: Wa Qilihi Ya Rabbi 'Inna Ha'uula' Qawmun La Yu'uminuna

v.t: Pardon them, and say, “Peace.” They will come to know
v.l: Fasfah `Anhum Wa Qul Salamun Fasawfa Ya`lamuna
